1.web: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ:
1.asv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ;

2.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
2.asv: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

3.web: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you towards one another abounds;
3.asv: We are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren, even as it is meet, for that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the love of each one of you all toward one another aboundeth;

4.web: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
4.asv: so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which ye endure;

5.web: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of the Kingdom of God, for which you also suffer.
5.asv: which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God; to the end that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

6.web: Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
6.asv: if so be that it is a righteous thing with God to recompense affliction to them that afflict you,

7.web: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
7.asv: and to you that are afflicted rest with us, at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of his power in flaming fire,

8.web: giving vengeance to those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
8.asv: rendering vengeance to them that know not God, and to them that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus:

9.web: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
9.asv: who shall suffer punishment, even eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

10.web: when he comes to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired among all those who have believed (because our testimony to you was believed) in that day.
10.asv: when he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be marvelled at in all them that believed (because our testimony unto you was believed) in that day.

11.web: To this end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith, with power;
11.asv: To which end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfil every desire of goodness and every work of faith, with power;

12.web: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
12.asv: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
